name: mirage
text: It already does. Every fair-odds source is read at the same time on each scan, as its own job, and Novig's books are read in parallel with them, starting as soon as the first fair odds arrive. That's why the last scan's fair-odds step took 7.8 s in total while Polymarket took 7.8 s, Kalshi 6.8 s and SX Bet 6.1 s on their own. The remaining slow part is the Novig side of a cold pass (about 14 books a second), not the odds sources.
